description: Add a song section with a click-to-load YouTube player to the www Storytime Advantage page at /products/storytime-advantage: local poster before the tap, phone video below 768 px, desktop video from 768 px, and no request to any video host before the tap. constraints: This opening writes only the track files. It builds no component, copies no poster, and writes no test.
The page makes no request to any YouTube or Google host before the tap.
The play control is a real button with a focus ring. The poster image has an empty alt.
The page stays a server component. The player is one small client component.
No date, no price, no learning claim, and no free trial on the page.
The poster bytes stay unchanged. The build adds no hash field to any file.
No push and no deploy. The push and the merge stay with Daniel.
Pathspec commits only. No git add -A, no git commit -a, no stash, no reset.
Commit headers stay at 100 characters or less and carry the track id (track_id: www_storytime_song_embed_20261104).
